finger_flex.label: Flex fingers
finger_flex.caption: Close and reopen all four fingers and the opposed thumb twice.

hand_sweep.label: Move whole hand
hand_sweep.caption: Translate and rotate the complete Macao hand while the fingers remain open.

hand_motion.label: Move hand and fingers
hand_motion.caption: Move the complete Macao hand through space while all four fingers and the opposed thumb close and reopen.
